_meta.description: Locked H3 (RQ3) malicious-rejoin success event rule and re-entry-prevention thresholds. Resolves spec v1.0 soft-spot 2 (GI-05 / MG-05) via Variant 2B (generous any-round-acceptance-within-window). Pre-registration evidence: locked before any H3 tau-calibration or evaluation run.
_meta.git_commit_stamped_at: 2026-08-09 (EXP-050 launch prep; director stamp per s7 Q3 ruling)

rejoin_success_rule.name: any-round acceptance within post-rejoin window
rejoin_success_rule.definition: A malicious rejoin is SUCCESSFUL iff the rejoining client's aggregation coefficient is >= alpha * normal_contribution in ANY round during the post-rejoin window of w rounds following the new logical identity's first participation. Otherwise the rejoin is UNSUCCESSFUL.
rejoin_success_rule.normal_contribution_basis: round-average aggregation coefficient over honest (non-flagged, non-malicious) participants in the same round

pre_registered_thresholds._note: re_entry_block_rate = blocked-malicious-rejoins / total-malicious-rejoin-attempts; benign_false_block_rate = blocked-honest-rejoins / total-honest-rejoin-attempts. Both per spec v1.0 6.3. Falsification: either threshold fails.
